input: Mutations read bounded UTF-8 JSON on stdin; no shell or paths in JSON.
rules: Read namespace revision and the current appearance revision before mutation. Independent display mode requires an explicit selected --target display-ID for presets and schedules.
Preset save/apply/delete JSON matches /api/presets: schemaVersion,action,requestId,expectedRevision,expectedCatalogRevision plus name(save) or presetId(apply/delete).
Preset contents include appearance only. Calendar credentials/sources, todos, timer progress, language, preview and host device policies remain unchanged.

Schedule update JSON: schemaVersion,requestId,expectedRevision,policy. Policy requires enabled,mode(interval|times),intervalMinutes(1..1440),presetIds,entries[{time:HH:mm,presetId}],manualGraceMinutes(1..1440). Use presetIds only for interval and entries only for times. Fixed times use the Windows local timezone; interval slots align to wall-clock intervals.

Provider update JSON: schemaVersion,requestId,expectedRevision,weather:{enabled:boolean,city:台北|東京|倫敦|紐約}. Global owner settings; no --target, network request, telemetry sample or desktop launch. Read --host-schema for exact JSON Schemas.

Focus update JSON: schemaVersion,requestId,expectedRevision,mode(normal|focus|showcase). Applies to all wallpaper views for the current live host session; resets at host restart. Screensaver privacy is isolated.
Replay identical request IDs and full payloads after unknown results. Reconcile revision/catalog conflicts; never silently substitute current revisions.
Committed settings or policy do not prove renderer application or OS visibility. This CLI does not forge acknowledgements or launch a desktop host.
